verdicts.V3_statement: WHAT THE tSZ OBSERVATION DECIDES.  (1) THE AMPLITUDE IS ALREADY CARRIED BY X-COP, SO IT IS A CONSISTENCY TEST, NOT A FREE PREDICTION: with the committed gas masses and the G095 identification (T = the virial temperature of the total enclosed mass, median hse = 0.99, 0.053-dex scatter), the predicted central Compton parameter is y0 = (sigma_T/m_e c^2)(mu/2 mu_e) times the LOS integral of rho_gas G M_HSE(<r)/r -- median 7.77e-05, all 12 in (1e-5, 1e-3) -- and the ratio to the baryon floor is the pressure-weighted G095 closed form, median 1.62 (the SZ face of the 3.57 temperature ratio read at the SZ-weighted radius).  A measured y0 disagreeing with the X-ray gas + kTvir by more than the ~0.05-dex HSE budget would indict the calibration, not the framework.  (2) THE NEWS IS THE SHAPE AT ARCMIN SCALES: the framework's Compton profile is beta-FORM inside (median fit RMS 0.008 dex; 10/12 well-constrained, median beta_eff 0.42 vs the classic cluster band 0.5-0.8; A1644/A2255 flat cores leave the inner form under-constrained), with an outer slope at b = 2 R500 of -1.44 (classic reading -3) and an outer signal ~105x the classic beta = 2/3, r_c = 0.15 R500 extrapolation at 2 R500 (per cluster 3-474x; window-average +1.50 dex over [r_M, 2 R500]): the DEEP-REGIME PHANTOM'S PRESSURE SIGNATURE -- the total mass keeps growing beyond R500 (phantom rho_ph = A/r^2, dust envelope), so the virial temperature stays at the T_inf = 2 T_floor = 3.6 keV-class level and the outer thermal pressure falls no faster than the gas envelope (the minimal case is A644, q = 3.8: the steepest gas envelope leaves only ~2.6x).  A tSZ measurement decides the per-radius virial reading: an ACT/SO-resolved or Planck-5-10'-beam y-profile whose outer falloff is steeper than ~ -2 at theta ~ theta_500 (median 16', phantom-zone crossing theta_M median 4.7') kills the extension of the G095 identification outside R500 and reduces the framework at cluster scale to G095's averaging-aperture statement; a profile as flat as predicted confirms that the cluster's missing mass is present in the outer gravitational structure -- the SZ channel sees the phantom through the temperature it imposes on the gas.  (3) NOT CLAIMED: y0 from first principles (the amplitude needs the committed gas and masses; the free-dust normalization stays open, KEPLER's honest register); the EFE cap's exact line at cluster scale (an active cap would suppress the phantom support and STEEPEN the outer profile back toward the beta reading -- the measurement discriminates the capped from the uncapped reading, G108's window); any per-cluster power law; and the resolution claim is stated at the survey numbers used (Planck 5-10' y-map beams, ACT/SO ~1').
